caption: The drawing depicts a wooden window with two rectangular shutters made up of vertical balusters framed by horizontal and vertical support beams. Each shutter contains a series of six turned wooden spindles arranged in two vertical rows, separated by a horizontal divider at the midpoint, making a total of twelve spindles on each side. The window frame and shutters appear in shades of light to medium brown, suggesting a wooden texture with visible grain patterns. The top of the frame is decorated with a carved, ornamental crest that features a symmetric, wavy design. The hinges on the shutters are metallic and positioned at the points where the shutters would pivot open. The drawing is signed "Niels N. Hansen" in the lower right corner. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional details or objects present.
title: Grille Doors of Wood
